risks.risk: Engine identity mismatch (wrong engine model/variant for the buyer’s car). Photos don’t show readable engine code/part number, so the exact engine can’t be confirmed remotely.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine code/label (e.g., stamped code on block/head) and the full engine bay tag/plate, plus the gearbox code if attached.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic complete used engine assembly with unknown compatibility (worst case: may not fit or may require additional parts).

risks.risk: “Working / no knock” not proven; could have internal wear, oil leaks, or timing/valvetrain issues not visible in still photos.
risks.proof: Short video of the engine started and idling (showing oil pressure light off, stable idle), plus a cold-start clip if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: treat as needing inspection/possible repairs).

risks.risk: “Never opened / low mileage” not verifiable; could be previously repaired or rebuilt.
risks.proof: Photos of fasteners/seals around the cylinder head cover, timing cover area, and any tamper marks; also show service history if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as previously used/unknown history (worst case: not guaranteed low mileage or un-opened).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts risk (alternator, starter, sensors, turbo/hoses, wiring connectors) not fully confirmable from these angles.
risks.proof: A full checklist photo: lay out and photograph all loose accessories/sensors/hoses included, and show the engine from multiple angles including front/rear connectors.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: buyer may need to source missing items).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code/label stamped on the engine block/head (and any ID plate), plus gearbox code if attached.
Video of the engine running (cold start preferred) showing stable idle and no abnormal noises.
Photos of key seal/tamper areas (timing cover/head cover edges, bolts, gaskets) to support “never opened”.
A photo-based parts checklist: show all included sensors/accessories/hoses/connectors and confirm nothing is missing.
response.reason: The photos show a complete engine assembly but do not provide readable engine identity or any proof of testing/condition. Without the engine code/model and running evidence, a worst-case price cannot be confidently matched to the correct comparable list.
